messages.content:
Read the requested notes and report actual findings. Project alpha-$TOOLS.
- load_skill
- read_file
- unload_skill
- edit: Edit notes
- inspect: Inspect notes

[skill edit activation 2]
Project alpha-$TOOLS. Write only when asked.
- load_skill
- read_file
- unload_skill
- write_file

[/skill]
Use read_file exactly once to read notes.txt. Then report the note marker and your project marker exactly as written in your active manual. Do not write any files or call another tool.

function.description: Activate one discoverable skill and its dependencies.
function.name: load_skill

function.description: Read an inclusive one-based line range; report I/O and range errors.
function.name: read_file

end_line.description: Last line; default 0 reads through EOF.

max_bytes.description: Maximum retained bytes; defaults to 65536. Omitted content is marked truncated.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.

function.description: Remove one explicit skill root; retain shared dependencies and past manuals.
function.name: unload_skill

function.description: Create a file and missing parents. Refuse replacing an existing file without overwrite:true; append mode creates or appends.
function.name: write_file

append.description: Append or create; default false. When true, overwrite is irrelevant.

content.description: Exact text to write; empty text is valid.

overwrite.description: Allow replacement of existing bytes; default false.

path.description: File path, relative to the Agent workspace or absolute; not confined to workspace.
